prompt:
Correct reference1 to match the STRICT ONE-INK-COLOR + WHITE CHARACTER STYLE in references2/3. This is NOT a multicolor chibi illustration. 
Every robot must use EXACTLY TWO colors: pure white and ONE single flat warm orange ink (#D99A4E). ALL outlines, visor, tiny details and occasional solid accent shapes use that SAME orange. Helmet, body, limbs, shoulders and armor interiors predominantly PURE WHITE. NO navy, black, gray, yellow, peach or different orange shades anywhere on a robot. NO shading, highlights, gradients, metal material or modeled volume. Don't merely recolor the navy gray or add pale tints. It must look like a simple orange marker drawing on white paper cut out as a sticker. At least 85 percent of each robot's interior is white. Tiny visor may be solid orange. SAME orange linework for all four identical robots.
Also simplify drawing: large rounded helmet with only two curved seam lines, short horizontal visor, rounded shoulders, one chest outline and circular chest core, stubby mitten arms and chunky short legs, only one boot line. Remove intricate torso/hip mechanical segmentation, kneepads and extra armor seams. Shapes awkward, sweet and hand drawn like the supplied simple character doodles. Keep robotic closed face without human eyes, hair or mouth.
Keep opening scene: foreground Golem hand over circular chest core with a small four-point orange spark; three identical smaller obedient robots lined up at right. Simplify factory backdrop to one orange outline rectangle, on a flat pale BUTTER-YELLOW background as reference2. White sticker silhouettes around all characters, white body interiors, flat orange strokes. No pink gradients, no halo, no shadows, no 3D perspective building. Landscape16:9. No text. All characters and scenery consistent in simple one-ink cartoon linework.
status: Corrected style sample: white characters with a single orange ink color, awaiting approval.
